apps.name: Beanshelf
apps.subtitle: Coffee bags, shelved.
apps.localizedDescription: Photograph a bag of beans and it lands on a wooden shelf. The label is read on-device to fill in roaster, origin, variety and tasting notes; rate bags Untappd-style in quarter steps, log every brew with its recipe, and share beans with friends — cards, bean packs, or the built-in feed.

versions.localizedDescription:
Report a bug from inside the app: Settings ▸ Feedback writes up what went wrong and files it straight to the project, with optional diagnostics you can read before they are attached.

Fixes: ratings no longer mix "3.50" with "3.0"; the leaderboard says "1 brew" instead of "1 brews"; and a bag added without a photo no longer has its name clipped by the rating stamp.
First release: the shelf, label scanning, brew log, leaderboard, themes, and the social feed.
